verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the Deel product. The only AI-related capability is an MCP server that exposes Deel data to external agents such as Claude or ChatGPT. That is a developer building block for outside tools, not in-product AI insight, and 'real-time cost visibility' is not described as AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Expose contracts, people, payroll, and time data to Claude, ChatGPT, or your own agent with Deel's MCP server.
The Deel MCP server exposes Deel platform operations as tools that AI agents and assistants can invoke directly.
